[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Glossary panel with term-and-relation navigation, project cycling, [/bold #D7AFFF]

[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A user drafting a prompt can press `gG` or `<ctrl+g>G` to open a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Glossary panel that browses one project's terms alphabetically, [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]cycles the visible project with `p`/`P`, and adds or deletes terms [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]through the same engine that backs the new `sase glossary add` and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase glossary del` commands.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shared glossary add/delete engine[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mutation[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mutation: build the project-scoped glossary write engine that resolves a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]target project's config, validates a candidate entry set through the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Rust glossary validator, applies a source-preserving YAML insert or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]removal with an atomic stale-write guard, and returns a typed outcome [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]carrying diagnostics and a restore command; add the shared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reverse-reference index alongside it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase glossary add and del commands[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mutation[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli: register `add` and `del` in the alphabetically ordered glossary [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]subcommand group, render rich and json outcomes, resolve `del` targets [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through the existing alias/prefix lookup, print the restore command, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]regenerate the project's agent instruction files in-process unless [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]suppressed, and extend shell completion and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Multi-project glossary catalog service for the TUI[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]for `p`/`P`, loads and compiles each project's glossary off the event [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]loop behind an mtime-keyed snapshot cache, exposes outbound and inbound [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]relation lists per entry, and invalidates cleanly after a write.[/#D7D7AF]
